consumedRepairBudget.rule: No product or test-byte repair owner is authorized for this frozen adjudication.

u6Boundary: The fixture seeds already-committed revision, change, and interlock rows with SQL. It does not prove authorization, admission transactionality, or the admission/result race; U6 remains the sole production admission owner.

verifications.command: pace-agent-runtime heavy --name artifact-review-typecheck -- pnpm --filter bb-plugin-workflows typecheck

shasum -a 256 plugins/workflows/src/workflow-terminal-settlement.ts plugins/workflows/src/workflow-terminal-settlement.test.ts plugins/workflows/src/service.ts && git diff --check -- plugins/workflows/src/workflow-terminal-settlement.ts plugins/workflows/src/workflow-terminal-settlement.test.ts plugins/workflows/src/service.ts && node -e 'JSON.parse(require("node:fs").readFileSync(".architect/evidence/artifact-review/section-1-terminal-kernel.json", "utf8"))' && ! rg -n 'admitContractRevision' plugins/workflows/src --glob '*.ts' --glob '!*.test.ts' && jq -e '.faultInjection.status == "killed" and .faultInjection.restored == true and .faultInjection.failed == 4 and (.faultInjection.killedBy | length == 4)' .architect/evidence/artifact-review/section-1-terminal-kernel.json >/dev/null

node -e 'const fs = require("node:fs"); const receipt = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(".architect/evidence/artifact-review/section-1-terminal-kernel.json", "utf8")); const allowed = new Set(["schemaVersion", "section", "unit", "adjudication", "priorReceipt", "immutableInputs", "consumedRepairBudget", "u6Boundary", "verifications", "faultInjection", "finalHashes"]); if (Object.keys(receipt).some((key) => !allowed.has(key) || /critic|review|verdict/i.test(key))) process.exit(1); const evidence = { ...receipt, verifications: undefined }; if (JSON.stringify(evidence).match(/independent|critic|verdict/i)) process.exit(1); if (receipt.priorReceipt.sha256 !== "e9c55885080b26b938d7e9b3147429325e3e560923748edc4a129dfd3e5d5849") process.exit(1)' && shasum -a 256 plugins/workflows/src/workflow-terminal-settlement.ts plugins/workflows/src/workflow-terminal-settlement.test.ts plugins/workflows/src/service.ts .architect/evidence/artifact-review/section-1-terminal-kernel.json && git diff --check -- .architect/evidence/artifact-review/section-1-terminal-kernel.json && jq -e '.verifications | length == 4' .architect/evidence/artifact-review/section-1-terminal-kernel.json >/dev/null

faultInjection.adjudication: The recorded kill is bound to the fresh restored immutable-input hashes; no new mutation was performed during frozen adjudication.
